text:

Not published. Verified 2 Sep 2026 (second pass).** Marg Gardiner · Council · incumbent (held City office 2022–26). Scored against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. Second pass: **n 13 → 15** (rows 16 and 51 added from Plan sentences no measure was holding), **2 📋 Record lines added** (rows 25, 35), **platform lastmod corrected** — the site is WordPress and publishes lastmod in its sitemap, so no cell says "n/p" any more. Internal proposal stays **C**, and is now stable under every downgrade tested. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Alignment compute APPLIED letter for Gardiner stays **D**. Incumbent: Record in the cell; a sourced miss caps below Close (max Partial+ 1.5). Do not stamp campaign 9.24 / 13.43 or the \$300M→\$160M reserve claim as ACTW figures. Lock is 13.3 → **7.28 overall / 9.34 residential / 4.78 business**. ## Card

### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **said** "Zero base all budget items with a view to holding tax increases to cost of living increases." Named NO on the 7 May 2026 budget (7.28 overall / 9.34 residential). Her reason is process and spending, not Kim's "tax hike was simply not enough." [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-passes-budget-in-debate-that-hints-at-start-of-election-campaign-12259094](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-passes-budget-in-debate-that-hints-at-start-of-election-campaign-12259094) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 7 May 2026 / press 9 May 2026
Downtown order M26 / M27 **said** "I have been a strong supporter of more bylaw and police enforcement on our streets." No Public Order Team and no 6am–10pm bylaw hours. The bylaw sentence is scored on M33, not here. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **said** "Review and amend housing bylaws to conform with the minimum housing dictates of the Province (e.g. the City's Missing Middle provides for 50% more units than the Provincial mandate)." Record: named NO, 26 Jan 2023. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-adopts-divisive-missing-middle-housing-program-6443676](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-adopts-divisive-missing-middle-housing-program-6443676) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 26 Jan 2023 / press 27 Jan 2023
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number do not appear. — —
Written program — **yes** Authorized 2026 campaign site with four named priorities, a plan-bullet list, a voting-record page and a current donate/volunteer ask. Written and current. No costed budget, no unit target, no implementation calendar. The \$300M→\$160M reserve sentence is a campaign claim, not a verified City figure. [https://marggardiner.ca/](https://marggardiner.ca/) · [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) retrieved 2026-09-02
--- ## The 12 topics No topic gets its own letter. Area columns stay blank. Rules as written on . Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date**. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Opposed −1.0** "Review and amend housing bylaws to conform with the minimum housing dictates of the Province (e.g. the City's Missing Middle provides for 50% more units than the Provincial mandate)." · Disagrees with M6 supply: the 2026 ask is to cut City housing bylaws down to the provincial floor. Record matches, not a miss: named NO with Coleman and Hammond, 26 Jan 2023. Context, same article, not a second mark: she tried to refer the motion and called it "a flawed concept." Context, same Plan page, not scored separately: "set housing targets more in line with current projected population increases." [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-adopts-divisive-missing-middle-housing-program-6443676](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-adopts-divisive-missing-middle-housing-program-6443676) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 26 Jan 2023 / press 27 Jan 2023
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — City land, a land bank and co-op financing do not appear in the 2026 Plan. Tenant displacement from assembly is diagnosis inside the housing-density paragraph, used as context on row 1, not a land-bank instrument. — —
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. Opposition to staff-issued permits sits inside the Delegation Bylaw sentence on row 53. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs and an expedited stream do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No unified command, co-location, or downtown operations desk. "More bylaw and police enforcement" is scored once, on row 10 (M33). — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — "Hiring of police officers who can handle traditional police work as well as outreach to street communities" puts outreach on sworn officers. That is not a civilian crisis-response capacity. Scored on row 33 as police funding, not here. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — More bylaw presence is named. Hours and a 6am–10pm standard are not. Enforcement without hours is scored on M33. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws **Close 2.0** "We have the bylaws to ensure safe streets. We need to enforce them." · Commits to enforcing existing bylaws. Comparable, not Same: daytime sheltering is not named. 18 Jul 2024 motion passed 8–1 with Kim the lone named NO; Gardiner is not named in that article. Do not invent a YES. No sourced miss, so no incumbent cap. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) **Partial 1.0** "Increase bylaw and police presence in neighbourhoods to enforce bylaws and laws regarding open use of illegal drugs." · Commits to open-use enforcement. Neither the buffer list nor child-focused geography is named. The Harbour closure motion is the SCS sentence already on row 23, not a second mark here. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting **Partial 1.0** "Ensure that the “solution” to street disorder downtown is not shifting encampments to neighbourhood park areas." · Commits to keeping encampments out of neighbourhood parks. No named-space protocol, no night-lighting programme, no removal sequence. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) **Close 2.0** "Zero base all budget items with a view to holding tax increases to cost of living increases." · Commits to a COLA cap on tax increases. Comparable to M66's residential-rate glide path, not Same (no year-path, no override rule). ZBB in this sentence is already scored from the homepage on row 41 and is not a second mark. Record is a hit, not a miss: named NO on 7 May 2026 with Kim and Hammond. Do not copy Kim's "the tax hike was simply not enough" onto her. Her named reason: "Gardiner called the entire process flawed" and "We are digging ourselves into a hole while deceiving the public with soothing words about making Victoria a wonderful place to live." Adopted bill is 7.28 overall / 9.34 residential / 4.78 business. Do not stamp campaign 9.24 or 13.43 as ACTW figures. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-passes-budget-in-debate-that-hints-at-start-of-election-campaign-12259094](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-passes-budget-in-debate-that-hints-at-start-of-election-campaign-12259094) · [https://www.victoria.ca/city-government/city-budget](https://www.victoria.ca/city-government/city-budget) · [https://vicnews.com/2026/05/11/group-consensus-victoria-approves-7-28-tax-hike-with-3-members-opposed/](https://vicnews.com/2026/05/11/group-consensus-victoria-approves-7-28-tax-hike-with-3-members-opposed/) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 7 May 2026 / press 9 May 2026 and 11 May 2026
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund and no debt-rule / supermajority override. CHEK 3 Mar 2026 names her as voting against reducing the debt-reduction reserve to zero; that is a reserve-contribution vote, not M66c's debt rule, and is not scored here. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number do not appear. Aging-infrastructure is diagnosis in the tax paragraph, not a household-bill figure. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger **Close 2.0** "The City must inform the Provincial government that we will henceforth accept only supportive housing that leads to rehabilitation and a pathway to a better life." · Commits to a stated refusal threshold on what the City will accept from the Province — M70b's third named instrument. Comparable, not Same: the test is therapeutic model, not indexed funding, and there is no quarterly downloading ledger and no twice-yearly UBCM/FCM resolution. Distinct sentence: row 23 scores the SCS / low-barrier opposition, and "the Provincial government fulfils its responsibilities of health care and housing" is context there. Record matches, not a miss: consistent four-year opposition to the City absorbing Island Health and BC Housing roles. **Added 2 Sep 2026** — this cell was a dash on the first pass; the refusal-threshold sentence was never carrying a mark anywhere. FLAG: Close is the high reading; Partial+ 1.5 if Joa reads one-of-three instruments as a target. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The CRD, regional water rates and the filtration plant do not appear. Committee seats (airport, SIPP) are a seat held, which the rules exclude. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office — No vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no one-mandate-not-a-new-office. Meeting Fernwood and North Park business owners is campaign colour, not a City mandate. — —
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour (Year 2 gated), no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — No 2026 text on government-to-government tables, Indigenous procurement, place names, cultural protocols or an urban Indigenous liaison. City biography and committee list checked. A dash is still allowed. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) — "As developers assemble land for larger developments, low-cost housing is demolished… often leading to tenant displacement" is a diagnosis of Missing Middle, already on row 1. No demoviction bylaw, no STR licensing, no indoor-heat standard. Mention, so a dash. M9c is struck. — —
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — Housing allocation and waitlists do not appear. Asking the Province to exempt supportive housing from the RTA is a tenancy-status ask, used as context on row 23, not a waitlist design. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput **Opposed −1.0** "I am opposed to the spread of “safe” illicit drug consumption sites and low-barrier supportive housing that permits illicit drug use throughout Victoria." · M11 is Housing First (low-barrier supportive housing + STEP throughput). Explicit disagreement. Context, same Plan, not scored separately: phase out supportive housing that allows illicit drugs; convert to sober / drug-free treatment; accept only housing that leads to rehabilitation. Record matches: she moved to ask Island Health to cease The Harbour "at the earliest opportunity," lone YES in a 7–1 defeat, 2 Jul 2026 (Kim absent). Verbatim from that meeting: "The Harbour has become a magnet for those addicted to drugs and for drug dealers who prey on the weak and defenceless." Second corroborating Record, same direction, 5 Sep 2025: her motion to press the Province to end decriminalization was defeated with her as the only supporter — "'Harm reduction' is an obscene phrase that obscures the harm done by illicit drug use." Both are the SCS / low-barrier sentence-family, not second marks. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://cheknews.ca/victoria-motion-to-close-safe-consumption-site-defeated-7-1-1333838/](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-motion-to-close-safe-consumption-site-defeated-7-1-1333838/) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 2 Jul 2026 / press 2–3 Jul 2026
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — Childcare spaces, family-doctor recruitment and the 18–25 cohort do not appear. M13 school food is \$0 and lives on M13d. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement **📋 Record** "I was successful in my motion to support the re-introduction of the Police School Liaison Officer program into schools." · Her own campaign page, attributed as a campaign claim — no independent press URL+date opened this pass, so no roll-call is asserted. A City–SD61 joint programme is not M13d's standing agreement, annual published work plan, joint public council-and-board meeting or single named contact, so it is neither a hit nor a miss. Shown, not scored; does not add to n. [https://marggardiner.ca/voting-record/](https://marggardiner.ca/voting-record/) lastmod 2026-03-29, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear in the 2026 Plan. City biography's 2022 "cleaner and inviting" theme is 2022 Record, not a 2026 Plan cell. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) — No corridor, signal, intersection, school-zone or Vision Zero position. M39 is struck — not scored. Fire / single-egress is a building-code file, not this cluster, and is not in the 55. — —
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — Walking, sidewalks, crossings and the City's own transit levers do not appear. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — City biography lists accessibility among prior community-service files. That is professional / community background, which the rules exclude. No 2026 washroom or accessibility-audit sentence. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — "Aging infrastructure" appears only as a tax-pressure diagnosis. No backlog number, no pothole standard, no sequencing rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Business harm near The Harbour is context on row 23. No cost-spreading instrument. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Paramedicine and call-volume reduction do not appear. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) **Partial 1.0** "Council must ensure that funding continues for foot patrols and the hiring of police officers who can handle traditional police work as well as outreach to street communities." · Commits to continued VicPD funding and hiring. No Esquimalt formula, no convene-and-publish regional review, no staffing number. Record is a hit, not a miss: named opposed to the 3 Mar 2026 4→2 cut, 5–4. "I support the police budget now and again this sleight of hand of ‘let's do two, as opposed to four,’ is a defund the police effort and I cannot support it at all." Context, same Plan, not scored separately: "I have opposed ‘defund the police’ motions." [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://cheknews.ca/victoria-approves-2-not-4-officers-for-vicpd-slashes-reserve-contributions-1309089/](https://cheknews.ca/victoria-approves-2-not-4-officers-for-vicpd-slashes-reserve-contributions-1309089/) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 3 Mar 2026 / press 3 Mar 2026
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target **📋 Record** "In spite of the many supportive items in the Mayor's Community Safety and Well-Being Plan, I voted in opposition for two reasons: the creation of new city shelters, and the implicit support of illicit drugs." · M31c is the measure that would turn that same CSWB plan into a performance contract (legal authority, lead body, timeline, target and cost against every commitment). Her NO was to shelters and drug policy inside the plan, not to publishing outcomes — so it is not Opposed on M31c, and it is not a hit either. No safety dashboard, no published enforcement record, no crime-reduction number anywhere in the 2026 text. Shown, not scored; does not add to n. "Measurable results" is inside the ZBB sentence already scored on row 41. [https://marggardiner.ca/voting-record/](https://marggardiner.ca/voting-record/) lastmod 2026-03-29, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage-era housing "at risk" from Missing Middle is diagnosis inside the row 1 housing paragraph, not a heritage-standards or cultural-venue programme. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Pedestrianisation and a signature project do not appear. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks **Partial 1.0** "Review City amenities with an objective of providing green space and community amenities throughout the city — all based on population densities." · Commits to a green-space / amenities review tied to density. No heritage-incentive schedule, no ornamental lighting, no parks acreage number. Distinct sentence from the urban-forest bullet on row 49. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Arts, sport and a funding floor do not appear. Hanging-flower-basket photo is campaign colour, not a culture-funding cell. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — "Focus operations on Core Responsibilities of the City" names a lane, not competitive testing of City services. Lane is not a source. Absence of a managed-competition vote is Record, not Opposed. Clearest method-rhetoric gap on the card. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews **Close 2.0** "I will zero-base the budget and demand every dollar delivers measurable results for residents." · Commits to zero-based budgeting. Comparable, not Same: all-items ZBB, not rotating 3–4 areas, no three-part test. "Measurable results" in the same sentence is not a dashboard and is not scored on M67. Record matches: at the 7 May 2026 vote she "called for zero-based budgeting lens." No sourced miss (she voted NO on the non-ZBB bill), so no cap. [https://marggardiner.ca/](https://marggardiner.ca/) · [https://vicnews.com/2026/05/11/group-consensus-victoria-approves-7-28-tax-hike-with-3-members-opposed/](https://vicnews.com/2026/05/11/group-consensus-victoria-approves-7-28-tax-hike-with-3-members-opposed/) Home lastmod 2026-04-21, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 7 May 2026 / press 11 May 2026
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard — "Every dollar delivers measurable results" sits inside the sentence already scored on row 41. One sentence, one measure. No KPI set, no cadence, no dashboard. — —
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. Core-responsibilities is a Mention on row 40, not an attrition rule. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. MBA / data-analysis background is professional background, which the rules exclude. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — Municipal use of AI does not appear. — —
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Procurement, open data, Wi-Fi and EV charging do not appear. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic — No 2026 climate-target, district-energy or seismic sentence. Climate Action Inter-Municipal Task Force is a seat held, which the rules exclude. — —
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness **Close 2.0** "Review Urban Forest targets with the objective of increasing canopy cover beyond parks through enhanced tree plantings in neighbourhoods, on boulevards and on private property." · Commits to a canopy-increase review via plantings. Comparable to the trees half of M59–M63, not Same (no 5,000-tree number, no 35% canopy, no emergency-preparedness position). Record matches, not a second mark: she moved the 3 Apr 2025 canopy motion; Saanich News 4 Apr 2025: "In a pitch from Coun. Marg Gardiner, staff will add five-year tree canopy (growth) targets in the draft OCP supporting a 40 per cent, city-wide 2050 tree canopy goal." Campaign table restates that hit. OCP adoption NO (with Hammond and Coleman) is a density vote, not a trees miss. No sourced miss, so no cap. FLAG: Close is the high reading of "review with the objective of." [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://saanichnews.com/2025/04/04/a-developers-wet-dream-and-a-renters-nightmare-victoria-plans-for-growth/](https://saanichnews.com/2025/04/04/a-developers-wet-dream-and-a-renters-nightmare-victoria-plans-for-growth/) · [https://pub-victoria.escribemeetings.com/filestream.ashx?DocumentId=101687](https://pub-victoria.escribemeetings.com/filestream.ashx?DocumentId=101687) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 3 Apr 2025 / press 4 Apr 2025
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule — No \$25M threshold, no 5-step sequence, no material-change rule. Amalgamation is scored on row 55, not here. — —
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response **Partial 1.0** "Expand the right of residents to be informed about, and to appeal, decisions made by City staff or City Council." · Commits to a notification-and-appeal right. Neither instrument in the cluster is named: no Integrity Commissioner, no 60-day published response to every consultation, no what-we-heard-and-what-we-did reconciliation 30 days before the adoption vote. Corroborated on the home page, "I will restore residents' right to appeal decisions and re-introduce meaningful community consultation" (lastmod 2026-04-21) — the consultation half of that sentence is row 53's IAP2 mark and is not scored twice; the appeal right carries this cell. **Added 2 Sep 2026.** FLAG, contested: a dash is also legal if Joa reads an appeal right as adjacency rather than a feedback-loop instrument. FLAG, evidence gap: her strongest Integrity-Commissioner line — the MNP recommendations being addressed before further major decisions — has no 2026-dated URL; the campaign [Resources](https://marggardiner.ca/resources/) page only *lists* the 2022 MNP governance review, which is adjacency, not advocacy. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://marggardiner.ca/](https://marggardiner.ca/) lastmod 2026-04-20 and 2026-04-21, retrieved 2026-09-02
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration **Partial 1.0** "Eliminate planned generous salary increases for City Councillors and the Mayor, limiting increases to cost of living." · Commits to COLA-limited remuneration. No lobbyist registry, no FOI-fee position. Record matches: named opposed to the 1 Aug 2024 remuneration package with Hammond; on 13 Nov 2025 she moved to cap the mayor's salary to inflation, named YES in a 6–3 fail with Hammond and Coleman. Verbatim from that meeting: "We need to cut the budget and as council we need to lead by cutting the purse strings on ourselves." CPI-only is the motion, not a second quote. Cluster mark is Partial because two of three instruments are absent. [https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/](https://marggardiner.ca/priorities/) · [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-approves-recommended-pay-hike-9302383](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/victoria-council-approves-recommended-pay-hike-9302383) · [https://cheknews.ca/showdown-in-victoria-city-council-chambers-over-salaries-1289363/](https://cheknews.ca/showdown-in-victoria-city-council-chambers-over-salaries-1289363/) Plan lastmod 2026-04-20, retrieved 2026-09-02 · vote 1 Aug 2024 / press 2 Aug 2024 · vote 13 Nov 2025 / press 13 Nov 2025
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Close 2.0** "Re-introduce the IAP2 consultation process — involve people in decision-making rather than informing the public after decisions are made." · Commits to IAP2 as the neighbourhood-consultation instrument. Comparable, not Same: not official-languages access and not two Local Area Plans per year. Context, same Plan, not scored separately: "Give residents a greater say in the densification of their neighbourhoods"; "Review and amend the Delegation Bylaw"; expand residents' right to be informed and to appeal.
